name: Preferences
description: Change the user's preferences: one map of what every agent acting for them should know, such as units, tone, timezone or diet. Your current preferences are in context; read x/preferences if they are not. Pick the change with `command`. 'set' stores `value` at `path`. 'remove' deletes the entry at `path`; with a `value`, it removes the items equal to it from the list at `path`. 'append' adds `value` to the end of the list at `path`, creating the list if needed. 'insert' puts `value` into a list before a position, with `path` ending in the position. 'merge' merges a map `value` into the map at `path`, or into all preferences when there is no path; a key set to null is removed, and any other value, a list included, replaces what was there. A path separates keys with '/', such as 'units' or 'diet/allergies'; a number picks a list item, counting from 0. Every command except merge needs a path. Use append or insert to add to a list.

path.description: Where in the preferences: keys separated by '/', such as 'units', 'diet/allergies' or 'diet/allergies/0'. Required for every command except merge.

value.description: The value to set, append or insert; a map to merge; or, for remove, the list item to take out.

ok.description: True when the change was made.

removed.description: False when remove found nothing to remove.
